title: FAIRGAME: a Framework for AI Agents Bias Recognition using Game Theory
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating strategic behavior, linguistic bias, and game-theoretic consistency across various models. While it discusses fairness, mentions ethical dilemmas, and uses moral archetypes (like Gandhi and Hitler) to test personality-driven strategic outcomes, its primary objective is a behavioral and bias-recognition framework based on game theory rather than a dedicated benchmark for religion, theology, or moral philosophy.
